title: Budget Cut Crisis
goal: A 30% budget cut has just been announced. Reprioritize the product roadmap, communicate the changes to all stakeholders, and manage the fallout professionally.
context_doc:
BUDGET CUT ANNOUNCEMENT

From: CFO Office
To: All Product Teams

Due to market conditions, Q4 budgets are being reduced by 30% across all departments, effective immediately.

Current roadmap (at risk):
1. SmartInsights AI feature — $300K — was planned for Q4 launch
2. Mobile app redesign — $150K — Priya's team is 60% done
3. Enterprise SSO upgrade — $200K — Tom Carter's clients are waiting
4. Performance optimization — $50K — Sarah says it's critical
5. New onboarding flow — $80K — Low priority

Total budget now available: $540K (was $780K)
You must cut $240K from the roadmap.

Stakeholder expectations:
- Mark: Protect Q4 revenue targets at all costs
- Sarah: Don't cut performance work or she says there will be outages
- Priya: 60% done on mobile — cutting now wastes $90K
- Tom: SSO upgrade was in his contract — he may leave without it
hint: Think strategically: which cuts have the least business impact? Communicate each decision with a reason. Acknowledge the difficulty. Offer alternatives where possible. Use data to justify choices.
opening_message: I just got off the phone with the CFO. 30% budget cut, effective immediately. I need you to come back to me with a revised roadmap by end of day. What's your plan?
